## `POST /api/v1/groups`

Create a group

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 409 when the name is taken.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `GroupCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `GroupOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `GroupOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/groups`

List groups

Lists the groups, newest first. `member` lists only the groups that principal belongs to now, and answers 404 when no principal has that name. Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. The cursor of the next page is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header and is absent on the last page.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | no | text or null | Only groups whose name contains this text, in any letter case. |
| `member` | query | no | text or null | Only the groups this principal belongs to. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most groups returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `X-Next-Cursor` of the previous page; send the same `q` and `member`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `GroupOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/groups/{name}`

Delete a group

Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 404 when there is no such group and 409 while an active grant, row filter or column mask still names it.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Group name. |
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `PUT /api/v1/groups/{name}/members/{principal_name}`

Add a principal to a group

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Adding a principal that is a member already changes nothing. Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 404 when the group or the principal does not exist.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Group name. |
| `principal_name` | path | yes | text | Principal to add. |
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

|---|---|---|
